results.name: UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors_multiset_prod
results.source_text:
theorem normalizedFactors_multiset_prod (s : Multiset α) (hs : 0 ∉ s) :
    normalizedFactors (s.prod) = (s.map normalizedFactors).sum := by
  cases subsingleton_or_nontrivial α
  · obtain rfl : s = 0 := by
      apply Multiset.eq_zero_of_forall_notMem
      intro _
      convert! hs
    simp
  induction s using Multiset.induction with
  | empty => simp
  | cons _ _ IH =>
    rw [Multiset.prod_cons, Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.sum_cons, normalizedFactors_mul, IH]
    · exact fun h ↦ hs (Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem h)
    · exact fun h ↦ hs (h ▸ Multiset.mem_cons_self _ _)
    · apply Multiset.prod_ne_zero
      exact fun h ↦ hs (Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem h)

noncomputable def normalizedFactors (a : α) : Multiset α :=

results.name: UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors_eq_of_dvd
results.source_text:
theorem normalizedFactors_eq_of_dvd (a : α) :
    ∀ᵉ (p ∈ normalizedFactors a) (q ∈ normalizedFactors a), p ∣ q → p = q := by
  intro p hp q hq hdvd
  convert!
    normalize_eq_normalize hdvd
      ((prime_of_normalized_factor _ hp).irreducible.dvd_symm
        (prime_of_normalized_factor _ hq).irreducible hdvd) <;>
    apply (normalize_normalized_factor _ ‹_›).symm

results.name: UniqueFactorizationMonoid.dvd_iff_normalizedFactors_le_normalizedFactors
results.source_text:
theorem dvd_iff_normalizedFactors_le_normalizedFactors {x y : α} (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    x ∣ y ↔ normalizedFactors x ≤ normalizedFactors y := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c, rfl⟩
    simp [hx, right_ne_zero_of_mul hy]
  · rw [← (prod_normalizedFactors hx).dvd_iff_dvd_left, ←
      (prod_normalizedFactors hy).dvd_iff_dvd_right]
    apply Multiset.prod_dvd_prod_of_le

results.name: UniqueFactorizationMonoid.dvd_of_mem_normalizedFactors
results.source_text:
theorem dvd_of_mem_normalizedFactors {a p : α} (H : p ∈ normalizedFactors a) : p ∣ a := by
  by_cases hcases : a = 0
  · rw [hcases]
    exact dvd_zero p
  · exact dvd_trans (Multiset.dvd_prod H) (Associated.dvd (prod_normalizedFactors hcases))

results.name: UniqueFactorizationMonoid.radical_dvd_radical_iff_normalizedFactors_subset_normalizedFactors
results.source_text:
lemma radical_dvd_radical_iff_normalizedFactors_subset_normalizedFactors :
    radical a ∣ radical b ↔ normalizedFactors a ⊆ normalizedFactors b := by
  obtain rfl | ha₀ := eq_or_ne a 0
  · simp
  have : Nontrivial M := ⟨a, 0, ha₀⟩
  rw [dvd_iff_normalizedFactors_le_normalizedFactors radical_ne_zero radical_ne_zero,
    Multiset.le_iff_subset (normalizedFactors_nodup isRadical_radical)]
  simp only [Multiset.subset_iff, ← mem_primeFactors, primeFactors_radical]

results.source_text:
@[gcongr, mono]
theorem toEnumFinset_mono {m₁ m₂ : Multiset α} (h : m₁ ≤ m₂) :
    m₁.toEnumFinset ⊆ m₂.toEnumFinset := by
  intro p
  simp only [Multiset.mem_toEnumFinset]
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt' (Multiset.le_iff_count.mp h p.1)

results.name: Physlib.FourTree.toMultiset
results.source_text:
/-- A `FourTree` to a multiset of `α1 × α2 × α3 × α4`. -/
def toMultiset {α1 α2 α3 α4 : Type} (T : FourTree α1 α2 α3 α4) : Multiset (α1 × α2 × α3 × α4) :=
  match T with
  | .root trunks =>
    trunks.bind fun (trunk xT branches) =>
        branches.bind fun (branch xB twigs) =>
            twigs.bind fun (twig xTw leafs) =>
                leafs.map fun (leaf xL) => (xT, xB, xTw, xL)
results.docstring: A `FourTree` to a multiset of `α1 × α2 × α3 × α4`.

@[simp]
lemma mem_toMultisetsOne_iff [DecidableEq 𝓩] {s : Finset 𝓩} (X : Multiset 𝓩) :
    X ∈ toMultisetsOne s ↔ X.toFinset ⊆ s ∧ X.card = 1 := by
  simp +contextual [toMultisetsOne, Multiset.card_eq_one]
